objective: Users can observe and recover their own local Alch functions through the service API while preserving state, deduplication and tenant isolation.

nodes.task: Specify desired mode, observed health, drain completion, generation fencing and recovery semantics.
nodes.done_when: Every transition, timeout, unknown outcome and activation interaction has one explicit meaning.

nodes.task: Map Function, Revision, RuntimeInstance, LifecycleRequest and DeliverySummary to existing source identities.
nodes.done_when: Stable record and relation IDs; inherited sources and new prototype meanings distinguished; no invented business entities.

nodes.task: Describe diagnose, drain, resume and recover journeys with tenant ownership and observable success criteria.
nodes.done_when: Each journey names inputs, permitted actor, output, errors and a user-visible completion criterion.

nodes.task: Define typed status/control contracts, registry transitions, runtime bindings and schema projections.
nodes.done_when: Trace each API field to its owning record or observation; validate source-derived schemas and supported DomainSpec binding claims.

nodes.task: Implement bounded host observations and a boot-time invocation gate.
nodes.done_when: Health exposes identity and gate; counters use read-only bounded snapshots; startup cannot accept invokes before durable mode is applied.

nodes.task: Implement durable lifecycle requests, explicit permissions, fencing and bounded background work.
nodes.done_when: Persist intent before effects; duplicate IDs return the same request; stale generations and concurrent controls are rejected; recovery is deterministic.

nodes.task: Integrate status/control HTTP endpoints, startup recovery and activation arbitration.
nodes.done_when: Status stays responsive during drain; invoke/restore/activate cannot bypass lifecycle intent; no status-triggered launch.

nodes.task: Extend the client in this successor packet with status and lifecycle commands.
nodes.done_when: Explicit fencing inputs and stable request IDs; GET-only waiting; no automatic POST retry; original client commands remain usable.

nodes.task: Author the integration fault scenarios and freeze the complete runtime/client/test dependency closure and usage documentation.
nodes.done_when: All executable dependencies, contracts and tests are hashed; predecessor evidence remains intact; one exact candidate is reproducible.

nodes.task: Run real isolated Rust-host fault scenarios and client/controller regressions against the frozen candidate.
nodes.done_when: All required cases pass against current candidate hashes; dependent unavailable checks are not_evaluable with causes.

nodes.task: Present the exact tested candidate and evidence for Alch product-owner review.
nodes.done_when: Owner decision binds the tested digest; changed bytes require new tests and a new decision; operational authority is separate.

operational_support.task: Provision a long-running service and issue lifecycle-enabled credentials
Plan and authorize migration of an existing registry root
Public endpoint, TLS, distribution and production rollout

implementation_boundary.predecessor_packets: read-only dependencies; preserve frozen sources and evidence
